description: Create a sales order in weclapp from a customer's order (e.g. an order mail). Required: customer_id (list_weclapp_customers) and items [{ article_id, quantity, unit_price? }] (list_weclapp_articles; without unit_price weclapp uses the article's price). Optional: customer_order_number (the customer's purchase order number — strongly recommended: if an order with this number already exists for the customer, it is returned instead of creating a duplicate, unless allow_duplicate is true), planned_delivery_date (YYYY-MM-DD), order_date (YYYY-MM-DD), fields (further weclapp salesOrder fields). The order starts in status ORDER_ENTRY_IN_PROGRESS. WRITES into the customer's ERP — it goes through the permission gate and the weclapp write log.

allow_duplicate.description: Create even if a matching entry already exists

customer_order_number.description: Customer's purchase order number; an existing order with it is returned instead of a duplicate

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

items.description: Order positions: article_id, quantity, optional unit_price (else the article's price)

name: create_weclapp_sales_order
